verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any user-defined rule or event-trigger system that fires actions automatically. The help center lists 定时任务 (scheduled tasks), which are time-based recurring schedules rather than event-driven rules. The IDE sidebar's vague mention of 'automated tasks' does not describe triggers either, so both are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
